items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: So Waverly went with me, and then we went there, and then I got all my shit together and I... He was supposed to be at the Congress Hotel.

ctx.x: So things kind of petered out in Chicago, and I went to New York to see Glaser... Because I had an apartment there, on Michigan Boulevard...not Michigan, on 55th -- 55th and Michigan. When I went back to New York, then I got Waverly(?) to come back with me... No, I went to see Glaser. I called him up and said, "I'm coming in." He said, "Well, be at my office at ten o'clock." When I got there at ten o'clock, he'd gone to Chicago.

So in the meantime, Gene had asked me about joining the band. Well, this is before... No, when I came back, he asked me. So I said, "Well, I'm going to go to Chicago, and I want to close up my apartment anyhow." So Waverly went with me, and then we went there, and then I got all my shit together and I... He was supposed to be at the Congress Hotel. Every time I'd call him, he just went out, you know.
